data: Chemistry for biologists: This course introduces students to the fundamental principles of chemistry with an explicit focus on their relevance to biological systems. Topics are motivated by examples drawn from cell biology, physiology, biochemistry, and microbiology. Experimental demonstrations and in-class problem-solving exercises connect chemical principles to the phenomena students encounter in their biology courses. The course has been designed to give biology majors the quantitative and conceptual chemical foundation necessary for advanced study in biochemistry, molecular biology, microbiology, pharmacology, and biomedical research
Associate Professor, Biological Sciences and Chemistry
